2032e827ba41f81e.description: About *** and the Role *** is a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider. As part of JD Logistics, the company operates extensive end-to-end logistics services globally. This full-time position for a Customs Clearance Coordinator is based in Dammam, Eastern region, requiring 2-5 years of experience in customs clearance. Role Overview The Customs Clearance Coordinator will be responsible for managing customs clearance activities in Saudi Arabia. This involves ensuring all documentation is accurate and submitted on time to facilitate the timely release of shipments. The role requires coordination with various stakeholders and adherence to Saudi customs regulations and compliance platforms. Key Responsibilities Coordinate customs clearance activities in Saudi Arabia, ensuring all required documents are accurate, complete, and submitted on time for shipment release. Review and organize commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, certificates of origin, and other compliance documents. Coordinate with licensed customs brokers for declarations. Utilize Saudi customs and compliance platforms, including Fasah, Bayan, and SABER, to track declarations, approvals, duty/tax calculations, and shipment release status. Verify HS codes, customs valuation, country of origin, and applicable certification requirements to ensure compliance with ZATCA, SASO, and other Saudi government regulations. Follow up on customs inspections, shipment holds, declaration discrepancies, and missing documents. Coordinate with customers, suppliers, customs brokers, and internal teams to resolve issues promptly. Coordinate import permits and regulatory approvals with authorities such as SFDA, CITC, and GACA, based on shipment requirements. Maintain accurate customs records and supporting documents, reconciling clearance charges, duties, taxes, and invoices for data accuracy and traceability. Monitor changes in Saudi customs regulations and policies, identify clearance risks, and support process improvements to enhance efficiency and customer experience. Qualifications and Requirements Education: High school certificate or above. A diploma or degree in Logistics, International Trade, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred. Work Experience: 2–3 years of relevant customs clearance coordination experience in Saudi Arabia, preferably in freight forwarding, express courier, third-party logistics (3PL), or logistics operations. Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with Saudi import and export customs clearance procedures, ZATCA and SASO requirements, HS classification, customs valuation, and country-of-origin rules. System Knowledge: Hands-on experience with or practical coordination exposure to customs platforms such as Fasah and Bayan. Familiarity with SABER product and shipment conformity certification processes is preferred. Core Competencies: Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, data reconciliation, and document management skills. Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to follow up on clearance exceptions effectively. Compliance Awareness: Strong compliance and risk awareness, with the ability to follow company policies, customs regulations, and business ethics standards. Other Requirements: Must meet applicable Saudi localisation (Nitaqat / Saudisation) requirements. Saudi nationals are preferred. Work Environment and Culture Joining JD Logistics means contributing to the future of global supply chain and logistics. The team values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. JD Logistics is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and is an equal opportunity employer. Application Process The salary for this position is not disclosed. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

20118761a0f136a6.description: About the Role State Street Corporation is seeking an Assistant Vice President (AVP) for Core Operations. This full-time role involves leading end-to-end post-trade custody operations in Saudi Arabia, operating from Sunday to Thursday. The AVP will ensure service excellence, strong risk and control discipline, and regulatory adherence across the Saudi post-trade ecosystem, including trading on Saudi Exchange, clearing via Muqassa (CCP), and depository/settlement via Edaa, with cash movements supported through SAMA. Role Context and Importance State Street is a global custodian with over USD * trillion in AUC/A, executing a growth strategy that includes expanding direct market presence. The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) is a priority market, supported by Vision 2030 reforms, increasing foreign participation, and strong institutional demand. This role is critical for enabling scalable market entry and growth by delivering controlled post-trade operations aligned with local market infrastructure and rules, ensuring a high-quality client experience, and supporting the firm’s ability to deepen client relationships. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end post-trade custody operations, covering clearing & settlement, cash & FX operational support, corporate actions/income, reconciliations, and client onboarding/account set-up. Drive service excellence, risk & control discipline, and regulatory adherence within the KSA post-trade ecosystem. Own daily settlement processing for Saudi Exchange trades, settling at Edaa in line with market cycles (standard T+2; negotiated deals T+0 to T+5, where applicable). Reconcile and validate client instructions, broker confirmations, and Muqassa clearing outcomes, proactively resolving exceptions and breaks. 209c4a4a2fb22989.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading risk management activities across a Giga Program, with a specific focus on roads, civil infrastructure, and structural works. The successful candidate will provide strategic and operational risk leadership throughout the program lifecycle, ensuring effective risk management, quantification, communication, and escalation. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain the program risk management strategy, framework, procedures, and reporting requirements. Lead risk management activities for roads, civil infrastructure, and structural works from concept and design through to handover. Establish consistent risk management standards across consultants, contractors, designers, and delivery partners. Provide expert advice to senior leadership on material risks, emerging threats, opportunities, and recommended responses. Facilitate risk identification workshops and reviews with project and functional teams. Lead and deliver quantitative cost and schedule risk analysis across the program and relevant project packages. Develop, implement, and maintain methodologies for cost and schedule contingency, risk allowances, and management reserves. Work with risk owners to develop practical mitigation and response plans, monitoring their effectiveness. Maintain the program risk register, risk breakdown structure, and risk taxonomy. Produce regular risk reports, dashboards, and executive-level summaries. Support procurement and commercial teams in identifying and managing risks during tendering and contract execution. Build effective relationships with program directors, project managers, and external stakeholders. Lead, coach, and develop risk professionals and project team members, delivering risk training and guidance. Risk Identification and Assessment Identify threats and opportunities related to highways, roads, bridges, tunnels, interchanges, earthworks, retaining structures, drainage, utilities, foundations, reinforced concrete, steelwork, and other structural systems. Assess risks using agreed probability, impact, proximity, velocity, and confidence criteria. Review and challenge risk assessments prepared by project teams, consultants, and contractors. Identify systemic, cumulative, and interdependent risks across the program. Quantitative Analysis and Contingency Management Undertake probabilistic cost risk analysis, including cost uncertainty and risk modelling, Monte Carlo simulation, and sensitivity analysis. Conduct quantitative schedule risk analysis, including review of schedule quality, critical-path analysis, and probabilistic completion-date forecasting. Translate quantitative risk results into clear recommendations for cost plans, schedules, and funding decisions. Establish appropriate contingency and reserve requirements based on quantified risk exposure and confidence levels. Monitor contingency drawdown, consumption, transfers, and remaining exposure throughout the program lifecycle. Maintain clear reconciliation between the risk register, quantitative risk models, cost forecasts, schedules, contingency, and management reserves. Governance, Reporting, and Stakeholder Engagement Prepare risk inputs for program reviews, investment committees, and board reporting. Escalate significant or deteriorating risks in accordance with the program governance framework. Coordinate risk reviews with schedule, cost, change, commercial, quality, health and safety, and issue-management processes. Manage risks arising from interfaces between various infrastructure components and operational systems. Communicate complex quantitative analysis clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Experience Candidates must possess over 10 years of experience in risk management. Demonstrated, hands-on experience in quantitative cost and schedule risk analysis and contingency management on major infrastructure, construction, or capital investment programs is a key requirement.

20a786f4061fad90.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الحدود الشمالية بمدينة عرعر. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية المتعلقة بتحليل العينات، وإجراء الاختبارات الكيميائية وفقاً للمعايير المعتمدة، مع الالتزام الصارم بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال وتجهيز وتحضير العينات لإجراء الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية. تنفيذ الاختبارات والتحاليل الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الطرق والإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للاستخدام اليومي. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد اللازمة لإجراء الاختبارات بدقة. تسجيل وإدخال نتائج التحاليل في الأنظمة المعتمدة ومراجعة دقتها بشكل دوري. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط ومراقبة الجودة على جميع عمليات الفحص والتحليل. المحافظة على العينات وسلامة تخزينها والتعامل معها وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المختبر والأجهزة والمعدات بشكل مستمر. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال والملاحظات الفنية المتعلقة بالأجهزة أو العينات فوراً. الالتزام بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية عند التعامل مع المواد الكيميائية والعينات. توثيق الأعمال والنتائج وإعداد التقارير المخبرية حسب متطلبات العمل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المختبر والمعايير المعتمدة في الجودة والسلامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تسجيل وتوثيق النتائج. الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة للحفاظ على بيئة عمل مرتبة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتعاون مع الزملاء. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مختبرات شركة اجال للمختبرات بمدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بإجراءات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية في بيئة مخبرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

20de81bd1c710886.description: About Jeeny: Jeeny is a mobile application that eases daily commuting and transportation. By connecting you with your preferred mode of transportation, we are fulfilling our aim of making mobility accessible, affordable, and flexible for all. We are a joint venture between MEIG (Middle East Internet Group), Rocket Internet, and IMENA. Jeeny was established in 2014 as Easy Taxi. However, in 2016, it was revamped as Jeeny to cater to other services. Currently, we are operational in Saudi Arabia and Jordan. We have offices in Riyadh, Jeddah, Madinah, Amman, Lahore, and Karachi. About the Role: As our Customer Communications Lead , you’ll own how we communicate with riders and drivers across all channels. You’ll bring structure to competing communication needs, set clear prioritisation rules, and ensure customers receive the right message at the right time. You’ll also lead experimentation across content, tone, offers and communication journeys, using A/B testing and performance data to understand what works and continuously improve our messaging. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong judgement, stakeholder management and analytical thinking, and wants to help shape the future of more automated and personalised customer communications. Responsibilities: Own our communications register, the definitive record of every message we send, who receives it, why it exists, who owns it, when it fires and how success is measured. Govern communications across teams and channels. Set and enforce the rules for frequency caps, suppression, priority, eligibility and exit criteria centrally, rather than one campaign at a time. Arbitrate competing sends, deciding which message reaches a customer at a contested moment and documenting the rationale. Design and run the A/B testing programme across content, maintaining a test register so experiments never collide on the same audience. Define the KPI for every message and work with data and engineering to close the gaps where performance cannot currently be read. Convert experiment results into a documented set of content standards for brand and content teams to apply at scale. Partner with data science on the automated decisioning engine, supplying the outcome data, guardrails and business rules it requires. Chair a regular planning forum where teams submit intended sends and leave with clear approvals, deferrals and rejections. Minimum 3 to 5 years in CRM operations, lifecycle marketing, marketing automation or campaign management, preferably within technology or consumer internet. Experience governing message volume across multiple internal stakeholders is essential. Hands-on experience with a customer engagement platform such as CleverTap, Braze, Iterable or Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including segmentation, frequency capping, suppression and holdout groups. Working knowledge of experimentation: sample sizing, control design, significance, and the discipline not to read a result early. Proficiency in SQL is a significant plus. Experience in handling operational and crisis communications with clear escalation rules. Experience managing multilingual and multi-market customer communications is preferred Demonstrated ability to write a data specification and hold a credible technical conversation with data and engineering teams. Proven experience operating across cross-functional teams and managing competing priorities without formal authority. Effective written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a decision clearly to the team it went against. What We Offer: An opportunity to collaborate with talented individuals while learning, growing, and expanding your skill set. An environment that encourages you to take ownership and produce excellent outcomes every day. Health benefits and insurance. Flexible working hours. Company Culture Jeeny is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a workplace where all aspects of employment are solely based on merit. We value diversity and absolutely do not discriminate in any form based on race, color, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, age, or mental or physical disability.

2042141b06b0115d.description: مقدمة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن مراقب حركة مركبات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخفجي. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان سير حركة المركبات بفعالية ودقة، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. نطاق الدور يتولى مراقب حركة المركبات مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع جوانب حركة المركبات، بما في ذلك تدوين البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بها، وتوضيح التعليمات الصادرة من الإدارة العليا. يضمن الدور التزام السائقين بالمسارات والجداول الزمنية المحددة، ومراقبة كافة العمليات المرتبطة بالمركبات لضمان الامتثال التام. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية لمراقبة حركة المركبات، وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. المشاركة في تنظيم جداول مواعيد وصول ومغادرة المركبات حسب المسارات المحددة، ومراقبة مدى التزام السائقين بها. مراقبة الأعمال والعمليات المتعلقة بالمركبات، مثل تدوين محتوياتها عند مغادرة المحطات، وحمولتها، وأوزانها، وأرقام سائقي المركبات، ووقت مباشرتهم العمل ونهايته. التأكد من الالتزام بكافة السياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في عمليات حركة المركبات. تدوين كافة التعليمات والأوامر والقرارات الصادرة في السجل الخاص بها، والعمل على إرسالها وتوضيحها للسائقين. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال مراقبة حركة المركبات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على فهم وتطبيق السياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية. مهارات جيدة في تدوين البيانات وإعداد التقارير. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات في المنطقة الشرقية، الخفجي. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

208e6b8004f441f3.job_title: CRM Dynamics Consultant - KSA - On-site - 4 Months
208e6b8004f441f3.description: About Octopus by RTG Octopus by RTG is the tech hiring and outsourcing arm of Robusta Technology Group , dedicated to connecting exceptional tech talent with top-tier organizations across the MENA, GCC, Europe, the US, and Canada . We specialize in building strong, long-term partnerships between skilled professionals and innovative companies. Our mission is to empower growth, innovation, and excellence by matching the right talent with the right opportunities. Key Responsibilities • Configure and customize Dynamics 365 entities, forms, views, and business process flows to support the leasing journey: inquiry (RIF/TIF) capture, unit listing sync, offer/negotiation status, indicative terms, and lease sign-off. • Build and maintain the integration layer (in coordination with the API Developer) that pushes/pulls data between the Portal and Dynamics — e.g., unit availability, agent assignment, inquiry routing, booking confirmations, and lease-status transitions (Prospect → Offer → Signed→ Active → Renewal/Termination). • Develop plugins, workflows, Power Automate flows, and custom APIs within Dynamics to automate leasing-team notifications and approval steps (e.g., move-in request approvals,addendum requests, operational date changes). • Model and maintain the account hierarchy needed for sub-accounts (MHR-03, MUT-16/17) and company profiles (MUT-31) within Dynamics. • Support renewal and termination workflows by ensuring Dynamics reflects and triggers portal-side renewal notifications (SRR/SRT) and termination/settlement records (FCR/FCT). • Build reporting/dashboards in Dynamics (or Power BI) for the leasing and community-management teams to track inquiries, conversions, and portal-driven activity. • Manage security roles, field-level permissions, and data-privacy configuration within Dynamics for portal-originated records. • Participate in data-mapping and (if scoped as a change request) data-migration exercises between legacy systems and Dynamics. • Support UAT for all CRM-dependent features and provide production support during hypercare. Required Skills & Experience • 4+ years hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales / Customer Engagement) development and configuration experience. • Strong command of the Dynamics customization toolkit: plugins (C#), custom workflows, Power Automate, Dataverse, and the Dynamics Web API / Common Data Service. • Experience integrating Dynamics with external web/portal applications via REST APIs or Azure integration services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management). • Solid understanding of the real-estate/leasing domain (or comparable long-sales-cycle CRM use case: inquiry → offer → contract → renewal/termination) is a strong plus. • Experience with Power BI or Dynamics native reporting for operational dashboards. • Familiarity with Dynamics security model (business units, roles, field security) and data-privacy considerations for resident/tenant personal data. • Working knowledge of e-signature and document-generation integrations within Dynamics (e.g., DocuSign for Dynamics) is a plus. • Microsoft certification (e.g., MB-210, MB-220, or PL-400) is preferred but not required. Success Criteria for This Engagement • CRM-dependent leasing features (JCR-06, JCT-06/10–13, and lease-status transitions across both portals) are correctly synced and demonstrable end-to-end. • Leasing and community-management teams can operate their day-to-day workflow from Dynamics with no manual re-entry of portal-originated data. • Reporting/dashboards give the Client visibility into portal-driven leasing activity.

20fd061b5b557e62.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Site Electrical Engineer to oversee and supervise all electrical construction activities on-site. The successful candidate will ensure that electrical works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes, quality standards, and project schedules while coordinating with consultants, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams. Key Responsibilities Supervise and monitor all electrical installation works on-site, ensuring compliance with approved drawings and project specifications. Review electrical shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, and technical documentation. Coordinate electrical activities with civil, architectural, mechanical, and other project disciplines. Conduct site inspections to verify the quality of electrical installations and ensure compliance with project requirements. Ensure proper installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems. Monitor contractor performance and ensure timely completion of electrical works according to project schedules. Ensure compliance with local electrical regulations, international codes, and health and safety requirements. Prepare and review inspection requests (IRs), testing reports, snag lists, and punch lists. Participate in project meetings and provide technical support, progress reports, and recommendations. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering. Minimum 10 years of experience in electrical site supervision for construction projects. Experience in commercial, residential, industrial, or infrastructure projects. Strong knowledge of electrical power distribution, lighting systems, low-current systems, grounding, and lightning protection. Familiarity with local and international electrical codes and standards. Professional engineering registration or relevant accreditation is preferred. Technical Skills Proficiency in AutoCAD , Revit , and Microsoft Office . Ability to review electrical drawings, calculations, and shop drawings. Knowledge of electrical testing, commissioning, QA/QC procedures, and inspection processes. Experience with project management software is an advantage. Core Competencies Strong site supervision and coordination skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management. Problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong technical knowledge of electrical systems. Attention to detail and commitment to quality. Time management and ability to work under pressure. Teamwork and leadership abilities. Strong reporting and documentation skills.
